title: Mimic a Hummingbird's Wing Beat
hook: Your arms spin like hummingbird wings.

beats.label: 30 SECONDS
beats.line: After thirty seconds, your heart rockets to 180 beats, you gasp.
beats.idea: Close-up of heart thumping fast, chest rising, character breathing hard.

beats.label: 5 MINUTES
beats.line: After five minutes, lactic acid burns, making your forearms feel like fire.
beats.idea: Forearms glow red, sweat droplets, muscle fibers trembling.

beats.label: 10 MINUTES
beats.line: After ten minutes, dehydration thickens blood, your pulse pounds.
beats.idea: Veins bulge, blood thickens, pulse visualized as drum beats.

beats.label: 30 MINUTES
beats.line: After thirty minutes, low CO2 makes you dizzy, the world spins.
beats.idea: Character sways, stars spin around head, floor tilts.

beats.label: 1 HOUR
beats.line: After one hour, you collapse, needing hours to recover.
beats.idea: Character falls to ground, heart slows, a timer appears.

description: A quick look at the physiological chaos of flapping your arms at hummingbird speed.

end.line: Would you try it? Yes or no.

topic: What happens if you mimic a hummingbird’s wing beat?
